metrics.design: every task where the prior's practice fails (21): replay, borrowing + fold (dimcode_s1 where the demo does not grasp) and the rank-16 LoRA rebuilt from IPEC episode 1 of the task's text (tags *_d1); same init states 30-49, 20 episodes; the practice decision is the prior's and does not depend on the demo

hypotheses.D1: borrowing + fold non-inferior to the LoRA at -0.10 with demo 1 (one-sided 95% cluster bootstrap)
hypotheses.D2: the same over both demos pooled (840 pairs; bootstrap resamples tasks, then demos and init states within them)

metrics.question: does the pre-registered result survive resampling the ONE demonstration?
metrics.written_before: any demo-1 final row of the 17 wave tasks (4 original tasks already had demo-1 rows)
